verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's core function is chatting with your own documents through a local knowledge base and RAG. It also auto-summarizes meetings into action items and key decisions. A hands-on user got largely correct answers over a batch of regulatory PDFs, though citations were somewhat garbled. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive or unprompted insights and suggestions beyond Q&A and summaries, reliable source citations, and in-depth docs on insight-generation features.
